summary: Itaú Unibanco filed a Form 6-K furnishing its condensed consolidated financial statements in IFRS for the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26). The filing is a routine periodic report containing operating results, credit portfolio growth, net interest income, efficiency ratio, and capital ratios. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, tender offer, or corporate action is disclosed. The document is purely financial disclosure under Rule 13a-16, with no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics. What to watch: standard quarterly performance metrics and any subsequent material corporate developments.
